definitions.explanation: Reading a book or text from beginning to end, especially one that is long or difficult. Implies effort and completion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長編|ちょうへん}→長編：14475_chouhen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読破|どくは}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I read through the long novel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{古典|こてん}→古典：00242_koten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読破|どくは}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧だ。
examples.english: I plan to read through the classics during summer break.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{分厚|ぶあつ}い→分厚い：10502_buatsui⟧{哲学書|てつがくしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{読破|どくは}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だった。
examples.english: It was tough to read through that thick philosophy book in one week.

notes:
Emphasizes the accomplishment of finishing a complete work, particularly one that requires sustained effort. The {破|は} character conveys the idea of breaking through or conquering, suggesting determination.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{長編|ちょうへん}→長編：14475_chouhen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読破|どくは}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: read through a long novel
- ⟦{全巻|ぜんかん}→全巻：17073_zenkan⟧{読破|どくは}: reading through all volumes
- {難書|なんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読破|どくは}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: read through a difficult book
- ⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{読破|どくは}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: read through in one sitting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {読了|どくりょう}: finishing reading — more neutral, simply indicates completing a book without the connotation of difficulty or effort
- ⟦{完読|かんどく}→完読：22581_kandoku⟧: reading to completion — similar meaning but less common
- ⟦{通読|つうどく}→通読：19800_tsuudoku⟧: reading through — emphasizes reading from start to finish without skipping, but doesn't imply difficulty
